dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Remember how helpless the people were, when the sky darkened and the Sacred Flame was snuffed out."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Victory is a warrior's mark of honor, excellence is a hero's chosen path."

dialogues.speaker: Anonymous Message
dialogues.text: "Verses sang in unison give strength to Tum{RUBY#[D]Hope}aini — they let the voices of Natlan pierce the darkness of the night..."
